      for distinct middle sets at Johnson distance d. Thus distinct pairs
      inside P_v have maximum relative codegree 2/[m(m+1)]. The P_v trace is
      naturally two-fold; simplifying it preserves this ratio.

      This O(m^-2) scale is only a projected fact. Full matching conflicts
      through Q_v retain relative codegree 2/(m+1), and lower-rank quota
      resources have nested correlations already equal to 2/m at depth one.
      The projected edge size is m, the full size is 2m+1, and an H-depth
      resource encoding has n(H+1) incidences. Uniform fractional weights
      also violate the floor entries whenever W/N_q is nonintegral. Hence no
      almost-perfect leave rate, hard-quota packing, Q_v conflict resolution,
      or exact residual completion follows from the star codegree.

      The precise unproved lemma is a quota-safe full-hypergraph matching of
      Cat_m-b wreaths with b=o(Cat_m/sqrt(m)), preferably O(Cat_m/m), whose
      residual is exactly wreath-factorable and whose same core respects all
      shallow quotas. Reports:
      `HARD_QUOTA_STAR_MATCHING_REDUCTION_RAW_20260724.md` and
      `HARD_QUOTA_STAR_MATCHING_REDUCTION_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1399. Global component-noise minimization gives another exact integral
      sufficient gate, but its submitted spectral baseline required a factor
      two correction. Put

          V_q(F)=sum_S(mu_q(S)-W/N_q)^2,
          V_q^min=N_q theta_q(1-theta_q).

      Then

          V_q(F)-V_q^min
            =sum_S(mu_q(S)-c_q)(mu_q(S)-c_q-1)
            >=2O_q(F).

      At a global minimizer of the weighted floor energy, fair complete-side
      choices in every ownership component remain exact factors and imply,
      for each transposition, that coherent displacement is at most component
      variance. With unordered coordinate transpositions counted once and
      all norms taken in the unnormalized counting measure, the exact
      aggregate used below is

          R_H(F)=sum_tau sum_(C in C_tau(F)) sum_(q<=H)
                   ||u_(q,C)-w_(q,C)||_2^2/c_q.

      Equivalently, R_H is four times the aggregate fair complete-side
      variance.

      Exact factor histograms have fixed nonzero point margins, while their
      centered vectors have zero total and zero point margins.  Those
      centered vectors therefore lie in Johnson harmonics j>=2, not merely
      the mean-zero space. Since the Johnson eigenvalue at j=2 is 2(n-1),
      the sharp form is

          sum_tau ||f-tau f||_2^2 >=4(n-1)||f||_2^2.

      Writing

          B_H=sum_(q<=H)V_q^min/c_q,
          O_H=sum_(q<=H)O_q/c_q,

      the corrected minimizer inequality is

          O_H(F)<=R_H(F)/[8(n-1)]-B_H/2.

      Hence the nonvacuous unproved sufficient criterion is

          R_H(F)<=4(n-1)B_H+o(nW).

      The criterion has the same fixed-window quantifier as the diagonal MWB
      reduction: for every fixed A, F is a global minimizer of the objective
      for H=ceil(A sqrt(m)).  Constants and minimizers may depend on A.

      The submitted 2n B_H baseline used only the generic mean-zero gap. It
      lies below the forced exact-factor floor by 2(n-2)B_H and is
      asymptotically infeasible on a nontrivial Gaussian window. At a global
      minimizer, the corrected criterion is a formal simultaneous
      o(W) floor energy, o(nW) aggregate fair-switch drift, and o(nW)
      spectral-excess near-equality requirement above Johnson degree two.
      No strict separation from merely having one low minimizer is proved, and no
      implication to or from RFEN, LM_A, or SCOV_A is proved.

      Marker/middle double counting does give equal average degrees in the
      natural one-marker formulation, so that equality is not itself an
      obstruction. The genuine completion objection is that marker-only
      dummy edges are not physical wreaths. Reports:
      `GLOBAL_COMPONENT_NOISE_MINIMIZER_RAW_20260724.md`,
      `GLOBAL_COMPONENT_NOISE_MINIMIZER_AUDIT_20260724.md`, and
      `GLOBAL_COMPONENT_NOISE_SPECTRAL_CROSS_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1400. The solver-free nonsaturated K=11 equality attack now has a complete
      audited one-defect normal form through rank four, but still no global
      contradiction.  In the Type-II chain-A branch
      `(delta_5,s)=(0,1)`, deleting the literal rank-five entries leaves a
      core C of length N=465-n5.  The exact one-defect path lemma gives one
      possible low triple carrier H and the injective collision row

          y2>=93+n5+Delta_lit.

      A genuine carrier has rank three or four.  The all-coordinate and
      all-codimension omission rows, rank-four surplus decomposition, and
      pair-cell injections give a finite lossless word-to-template
      recursion.  At equality in the collision row, every physical pair
      and triple cell is assigned: the lower pair colors form one rainbow
      path with one low seam, all other transitions are distinct rank-five
      targets, and every central four-window is a distinct selected
      rank-six witness.  The four-window conclusion uses the full interval
      antichain argument: 462 equal-rank witnesses in 465 positions have
      common endpoint order and length at most four.

      The top zero-margin slices are now exact:

      * n5=134 is impossible, because the total rank-four component slack is
        one while a rank-four or rank-three carrier needs central slack at
        least two or three;
      * n5=133 forces

            x4=0, s3=1, rho=4, tstar=2,
            Delta_lit=103-n4,
            y1=n4, y2=329-n4.

        Its actual segment is `P4 || D3 || Q4`; all pairs of D3 except the
        two seam pairs are rank-four witnesses, every triple except H is a
        rank-five witness, and every four-window is rank six.  The seam is
        of type (2,3), (3,2), or (3,3), with the displayed local forms in
        the report.  The zero-run ledger has exactly three or two length-two
        runs according to seam type and at most three length-three runs;
      * n5=132 has exactly five coarse necessary modes A,B,C0,C1,D for
        `(x4,s3,rho,tstar,g)`, with the exact counts listed in the report.

      The duplicate-free two-component chain-B branch has its own exact
      row

          y2>=95+n5+Delta_lit,

      carrier-free recursive normal form, and a top-slice physical-seam
      theorem locating D3 inside the slack-two component.  Chain C is its
      reversal.  All uses of “classification” here mean necessary
      word-to-template data; no converse realizability is asserted.  The
      summed binomial moment rows are restricted to 0<=t<=10, while their
      pointwise forms hold for every coordinate set.

      These theorems do not prove nu(11)>465, so the certified interval
      remains [465,477].  Reports and two independent audits:
      `K11_NONSATURATED_ONE_DEFECT_CORE_20260724.md`,
      `K11_NONSATURATED_ONE_DEFECT_CORE_AUDIT_20260724.md`,
      `K11_NONSATURATED_ONE_DEFECT_CORE_FINAL_AUDIT_INTERNAL_20260724.md`,
      and `K11_NONSATURATED_ONE_DEFECT_CORE_FINAL_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1401. The corrected global component-noise criterion admits an exact
      three-slack decomposition which shows that it is stronger than the
      desired balancing conclusion, not an easier mixing reformulation.
      For a global minimizer of the fixed H-window floor energy, put

          Q_H=sum_(q<=H)(||f_q||_2^2-V_q^min)/c_q,
          S_H=B_H+Q_H,
          D_H=sum_tau sum_(q<=H)||f_q-tau f_q||_2^2/c_q.

      Component equivariance holds separately for every transposition:
      the right rows of each overlap component are exactly the transposed
      left rows, so each component difference has zero total and zero point
      margins.  With R_H the unscaled component-noise sum from item 1399,
      the exact identity is

          R_H-4(n-1)B_H
           =(R_H-D_H)
            +(D_H-4(n-1)(B_H+Q_H))
            +4(n-1)Q_H.

      All three terms are nonnegative at a global minimizer.  Hence the
      proposed upper gate already contains Q_H=o(W), plus o(nW) fair-switch
      drift and o(nW) Johnson degree-at-least-three spectral excess.  It
      cannot be derived merely from zero point margins, overlap
      connectivity, or minimality; a connected-overlay countermodel makes
      this logical obstruction explicit.

      Equality is very rigid.  For each fixed transposition, component
      wall-crossing supports become targetwise disjoint, every load is
      floor-balanced, and every centered bonus indicator lies in Johnson
      degree two.  Two exact Boolean obstructions are now proved:

      * for every m>=18, no balanced first-shadow bonus family can have its
        centered indicator in E_2;
      * more generally, for 2<=r<=m, s=n-r+1, density theta, and

            b=4m theta, d=4m(1-theta),

        no nontrivial Boolean E_2 family exists when

            r>4, b<s, 3s<d<5(s-b).

        Asymptotically this excludes fixed limiting densities in (0,1/16)
        and, by complementation, (15/16,1) on central ranks.

      The proof is an exact full-facet cascade: every bonus set would have
      exactly four nonfull facets; the injective up operator transfers E_2
      to the full-facet family, whose actual boundary degree 4s exceeds the
      E_2 value below 4m.

      On H=ceil(A sqrt(m)), the unavoidable baseline satisfies

          B_H~kappa_A W sqrt(m),
          kappa_A=integral_0^A
             {exp(x^2)}(1-{exp(x^2)})
             /[floor(exp(x^2)) exp(x^2)] dx >0.

      The exact row self-energy at rank r is

          2W[r(n-r)-2].

      At the first shadow it is 2W(m^2+m-4), versus spectral-floor scale
      16W(m-2)/(m+2); floor-scale control needs cancellation of all but
      O(m^-2) of the row diagonal inside the actual overlap components.

      The exact exclusions do not yet refute the o(nW)-slack gate.  A
      uniform sparse Boolean-E_2 stability theorem on the slice would do
      so on positive parts of a Gaussian window.  That theorem was open at
      this stage and is proved later in item 1405.  Reports and audits:
      `GLOBAL_COMPONENT_NOISE_GATE_NO_GO_20260724.md`,
      `GLOBAL_COMPONENT_NOISE_GATE_NO_GO_AUDIT_20260724.md`,
      `COMPONENT_NOISE_OVERLAP_IDENTITY_20260724.md`, and
      `COMPONENT_NOISE_OVERLAP_IDENTITY_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1402. The zero-margin K=11 survivors from item 1400 satisfy a further
      audited window, endpoint, and Johnson-path normal form.  Let

          B_i=A_i union A_(i+1),
          C_i=A_i union A_(i+1) union A_(i+2),
          T_i=A_i union ... union A_(i+3)

      on the central rank-at-most-three segment.  There is one seam triple
      H=C_s of rank rho in {3,4}; every other C_i is a distinct five-set and
      every T_i is a distinct six-set.

      Consecutive T_i form a simple path in J(11,6), except possibly at the
      seam.  If the seam transition has Johnson distance 1+eta, then

          0<=eta<=5-rho.

      Every ordinary five-window has rank seven, and an internal
      seam-centered five-window has rank 7+eta.  The coordinate zero-run
      ledger is exact:

          # exact length-three zero runs = 7-rho-eta.

      Every length-two zero run is localized to an endpoint, a low seam
      pair, or the one additional low pair in mode C0.  At n5=133 each
      coordinate x obeys the separate identity

          Z_x+lambda_x+r_x
            =65+1_(x in H)+2*1_(x in I),

      where I is the intersection of the two seam-pair colors.  Analogous
      exact coordinate equations hold in all five n5=132 modes.

      Equality in the external endpoint charges also forces a new global
      structure.  Once the selected witness families are fixed, the full
      rank-five and rank-six layers are paired in common endpoint order by
      strict inclusion.  Each coordinate is the unique added coordinate on
      exactly 42 matching edges.  The rank-six interval-offset schedule is

          01* 02* 03* 13* 23*,

      and the central four-window block is the 03 block.  Combining this
      matching with the six possible chain-A rank-five offset blocks gives
      a spanning rainbow linear forest in J(11,5) with c<=6 components and

          |E|=462-c>=456

      distinct rank-six union colors.  Expanding each forest edge through
      its six-set color and adding the one unused matching edge at each root
      yields c vertex-disjoint alternating paths covering all 924 vertices
      in ranks five and six.  If f_x counts forest edges with coordinate
      label x and d_x counts unused matching additions, then

          f_x+d_x=42,
          sum_x d_x=c,
          42-c<=f_x<=42.

      The corresponding componentwise zero-run and endpoint-label laws are
      equations (3.22)--(3.24) of the report.

      This is a genuine finite strengthening but not a contradiction: the
      at-most-six unused matching edges and the external extension labels
      can still absorb every coordinate deficit.  The remaining route would
      need a theorem controlling central six-set point degrees, endpoint
      six-sets, repeated three-set intersection colors, or rank-seven
      congestion.  The certified interval for nu(11) remains [465,477].
      Report and independent audit:
      `K11_ZERO_MARGIN_WINDOW_ATTACK_20260724.md` and
      `K11_ZERO_MARGIN_WINDOW_ATTACK_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1403. The K=11 middle-level path cover from item 1402 satisfies a further
      audited subset-flow hierarchy.  For every coordinate set X of size
      t<=6, the perfect rank-five/rank-six inclusion matching has exactly

          Delta_t=C(11-t,6-t)-C(11-t,5-t)

      edges which complete X, with

          (Delta_1,...,Delta_6)=(42,42,28,14,5,1).

      Resolving these completions along the oriented alternating paths gives
      exact entry, exit, bypass, root, and omitted-colour equations.  At
      t=4 they determine every rank-four intersection-colour multiplicity
      from endpoint and cut data; at t=5 they give the sharp endpoint cut

          mu_X<=4+tau_X+sigma_X.

      More importantly, the formerly free central/external split of the 42
      extension labels is now exact.  If R_x^(3) is the number of zero runs
      of coordinate x of length at least three in the low-entry segment and
      H is the exceptional triple, then

          e_x^cen=R_x^(3)-1+1_(x in H),
          e_x^ext=43-R_x^(3)-1_(x in H).

      For an internal seam, c>=2; the two roots P,Q and omitted colours U,V
      obey

          |P intersect Q|=3-eta,
          U intersect V=(P intersect Q) union {p,q},

      and the seam-local exact length-three zero-run coordinates are
      precisely the set difference (P intersect Q) minus H.  These identities
      do not yet contradict
      the external offset capacity, so nu(11) remains in [465,477].  Report
      and audit: `K11_MIDDLE_LEVELS_NEWLINE_20260724.md` and
      `K11_MIDDLE_LEVELS_NEWLINE_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1404. Fixed aggregated multitransposition heat has an exact audited no-go
      structure.  For a transposition-generated subgroup G, the join of
      the owner-component partitions is the row/orbit incidence quotient of
      the G-Schreier graph on middle sets.  Connected coordinate support
      therefore makes the common owner partition one block.  A fixed
      connected-support word or commutator offers only whole endpoint
      relabellings under the canonical component-side mechanism and has
      exactly zero floor-corrected drift.

      Disconnected support preserves exact target-orbit totals.  These give
      explicit orbit-profile floors Omega_(q,G) for balanced overload and
      B_(q,G) for quadratic energy, with B_(q,G)>=2 Omega_(q,G).  Along any
      spanning tree of coordinate transpositions these nonnegative profile
      floors telescope exactly from the full defect to zero, so some bridge
      releases at least a 1/(n-1) share of the relaxed weighted defect.

      There is also an exact subgroup heat identity.  Independently
      relabelling every joined owner block by a uniform element of G stays
      inside the exact-factor fibre and satisfies

          E Q_q(child)=B_(q,G)+C_(q,G),

      where C_(q,G)>=0 is the harmful component excess.  For the point
      stabilizer S_(n-1), exact point margins make B_(q,G)=0, but every row
      meets both middle orbits, the owner quotient has one block, and

          C_(q,G)=Q_q(F).

      Thus even perfect coherent smoothing is restored completely as
      component noise.  Fixed aggregated subgroup heat cannot prove MWB;
      components must be recomputed adaptively, or additional perfect
      matchings inside the combined supports must be constructed.  Report
      and audit: `COMPONENT_NOISE_NEW_EXPLORATION_20260724.md` and
      `COMPONENT_NOISE_NEW_EXPLORATION_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1405. A uniform sparse Boolean-E_2 stability theorem now refutes the
      corrected near-baseline component-noise gate itself.  Put

          theta_*=(3-sqrt(6))/6=0.091751... .

      For every fixed central-window constant A_0 and compact
      I subset (0,theta_*), there is epsilon_I>0 such that every Boolean
      family B in a rank |r-n/2|<=A_0 sqrt(n), of density theta in I,
      satisfies

          ||P_(E_1 plus E_>=3)(1_B-theta)||_2^2
             >=epsilon_I C(n,r).

      The proof is self-contained.  Every E_2 function is a harmonic
      quadratic form with zero matrix row sums; its standardized third
      moment is at most 2 sqrt(2)+O_A(1/n), while the centered Boolean skew
      exceeds 2 sqrt(2) exactly below theta_*.  An absolute fourth-moment
      bound transfers the strict skew gap into the displayed L2 stability.

      Rounding an integer wreath load to a balanced Boolean bonus family
      and using the exact three-slack component ledger then gives, at every
      same-window global minimizer and every fixed A>0,

          R_H-4(n-1)B_H=Omega_A(n W sqrt(m)),
          H=ceil(A sqrt(m)).

      Hence the proposed sufficient gate

          R_H<=4(n-1)B_H+o(nW)

      is quantitatively impossible on every nontrivial fixed Gaussian
      window.  This kills that component-noise proof architecture, not MWB
      or the contiguous-OR conjecture.  Report and audit:
      `MATH_ATTACK_D_BOOLEAN_E2_STABILITY_20260724.md` and
      `MATH_ATTACK_D_BOOLEAN_E2_STABILITY_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1406. The proposed primitive dominant-ray three-box theorem is false.  Let
      0<a<b and c>2b be fixed positive integers.  A new finite witness-order
      argument proves

          liminf_(t->infinity)
          [g_3(at,bt,ct)-(at+1)(bt+1)]/t^2
            >=ab(c-2b)/(c+5a+5b)>0.

      The proof orders one selected interval witness for every point in the
      full rectangular middle layer.  Their left and right endpoints are
      both strictly increasing and can be written i+alpha_i and i+beta_i,
      with total slack D=N-width.  Below-middle targets give the exact
      rank-capped start bound

          L_<h <= sum_i(beta_i-alpha_i)+(h-1)D.

      Every block of p+q+2 middle targets contains a short internal positive
      coordinate-threshold run.  A literal pin from one positive witness,
      without any common-pin assumption, forces a gap between the two
      neighboring negative witnesses.  Pairing balanced blocks and charging
      the monotone alpha/beta increments yields

          sum_i(beta_i-alpha_i)<=qN+2BD,

      which gives the displayed quadratic ray bound.  The example
      (a,b,c)=(1,2,5) already has excess at least (1/10-o(1))t^2.

      Consequently the earlier DRAY target and the uniform compact-balanced
      three-box hypothesis CB are impossible on a whole fixed-ratio cone.
      This invalidates that local product-box completion route, but does not
      refute the global contiguous-OR conjecture or constructions which
      share witnesses across different product boxes.

      A complementary audited corridor analysis proves the exact plateau
      throughput lower bound

          g_3(p,q,r)>= (p+1)(q+1)+ceil((r-p-q)/2)

      on the relevant finite/asymptotic range, forces vertical endpoint
      ownership in the formal width-equality geometry, gives exact turnover
      identities with d surplus endpoints, and shows that any
      certificate-preserving fusion of the canonical outer-hook atoms with
      at most three local roles per physical position cannot attain
      asymptotic width when c>2b.  Thus even inside that narrower
      architecture the missing sharing would have to be genuinely global.

      Reports and audits:
      `MATH_ATTACK_F_DRAY_CONSTRUCTION_20260724.md`,
      `MATH_ATTACK_F_DRAY_CONSTRUCTION_AUDIT_20260724.md`,
      `THREEBOX_CORRIDOR_NEWLINE_20260724.md`, and
      `THREEBOX_CORRIDOR_NEWLINE_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1407. The remaining K=11 external extension-label freedom from item 1403
      satisfies an audited set-valued Hall/capacity system.  External
      matching edges are bijectively anchored at the outer word positions.
      For every coordinate set X, let e_ext(X) be the number of external
      matching edges which complete X.  With E the external matching mass,
      s_X the external source-star count, a_X the anchor-star count, d_X the
      directed offset capacity, and u_X the exposed three-cell capacity,

          e_ext(X)<=min{E-s_X,E-a_X,d_X}<=3u_X.

      The subset-completion hierarchy simultaneously gives

          Delta_|X|-kappa_X^cen <= e_ext(X),

      where kappa_X^cen is the central completion count.  For single
      coordinates, combining this with

          e_x^ext=43-R_x^(3)-1_(x in H)

      yields the exact global zero-tail bound

          sum_over_zero_runs (length-3)_+ <=210.

      In the n5=133 template, the same capacities give explicit new
      coordinate inequalities coupling literal rank-five incidence,
      lambda_x, repeated-entry incidence, the length-one/two/three run
      counts, and the six-cell boundary exposure sets.

      These constraints still do not contradict a zero-margin survivor.
      For |X|>=2 the coarse subset-star bounds are numerically vacuous at the
      present external mass, so the live finite gate is order-sensitive: one
      must control the actual literal rank-five source family or the directed
      three-cell exposure sets well enough to violate the Hall capacity for
      some X.  Reports: `K11_EXTERNAL_OFFSET_CAPACITY_20260724.md` and
      `K11_EXTERNAL_OFFSET_CAPACITY_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1408. The three-box obstruction from item 1406 has a stronger unrestricted
      two-endpoint dual.  For 1<=p<=q and r>=p+q, put

          W_3=(p+1)(q+1).

      Then every range-maximum word satisfies

          g_3(p,q,r)
            >=W_3+ceil[W_3(r-p-q)/(2r)].

      The proof chooses arbitrary witnesses for the full plateau slab and
      partitions them both by left endpoint and by right endpoint.  Each is
      a chain partition, and the two partitions are orthogonal.  Consecutive
      plateau ranks force many target-poset cover edges in each partition.
      The conserved horizontal potential x+y bounds the horizontal covers,
      while a vertical target cover cannot occur in both endpoint
      partitions.  Coupling the two ledgers gives the displayed excess.

      A sloped-band refinement is also exact.  For 0<=k<=p it gives

          g_3(p,q,r)-W_3
           >=ceil_+ {[(r-p-q+2k)W_3
                +k(k+1)(k-6p-6q-4)/3]/[2(r+2k)]}.

      In particular the excess is already Omega(t^2) on every fixed width
      boundary ray r=p+q, and remains quadratic throughout the complete
      width plateau r>=p+q.  Thus neither DRAY nor any uniform local
      width-plus-o(R^2) three-box theorem can be repaired by changing the
      aspect-ratio cutoff.  Report and external audit:
      `MATH_ATTACK_S2_DRAY_DUAL_20260724.md` and
      `MATH_ATTACK_S2_DRAY_DUAL_CROSS_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1409. The failure of local three-box width is not negligible under the
      Boolean three-block SCD aggregation.  For three equal coordinate
      blocks, a uniformly chosen SCD chain height divided by sqrt(s)
      converges to the Rayleigh density y exp(-y^2/2).  For three independent
      heights, the sorted dominant event

          L_(3)>2 L_(2)

      has exact limiting probability 1/5 (one prescribed labelled ordering
      has probability 1/30).  Every compact subcone of that event has a
      uniform local Omega(k) three-box excess, and therefore contributes
      Omega(W(k)) aggregate excess.  Separate boxwise concatenation fails
      for every three-way block split, including fixed, vanishing, and
      degenerate proportions; merging additional atomic blocks back into
      three macro-SCDs does not change the height histograms.

      More generally, for a fixed positive-proportion d-block split, the
      exact averaged local gate is

          E E_d(L_1,...,L_d)=o(k^((d-1)/2)),

      where E_d=g_d-w_d.  The d=3 gate is impossible; the fused four-box
      average E E_4=o(k^(3/2)) is the first surviving fixed-dimensional
      local gate.

      Arbitrary seam-crossing global witnesses still obey two exact sharing
      ledgers.  Projecting every global letter to each SCD box gives a valid
      local range-maximum word, and restricting selected witnesses gives the
      two endpoint partitions from item 1408.  Hence a near-width global word
      must supply Omega(W(k)) letter-box or endpoint-box sharing capacity.
      Sparse o(W) portals of bounded box degree, including O(sqrt(s))-length
      seams per typical box, cannot amortize the local gaps.  The honest
      escapes are Omega(s)-scale packet fusion per bad box or unbounded-degree
      genuinely global portals.

      Reports and audits: `PRODUCT_ROUTE_AFTER_DRAY_NO_GO_20260724.md`,
      `PRODUCT_ROUTE_AFTER_DRAY_NO_GO_AUDIT_20260724.md`,
      `CROSS_BOX_SHARING_AFTER_DRAY_20260724.md`, and
      `CROSS_BOX_SHARING_AFTER_DRAY_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1410. The surviving direct adaptive-MTF target admits an audited literal
      two-part weakening.  For H-legal middle-layer path pieces with endpoint
      states Pi_j, let s=2H+2 and let b_j be the least number of nonempty MTF
      updates carrying the terminal state of one ordered piece exactly to the
      initial state of the next.  The exact portal excess is

          P_H=(s-1)+sum_j(b_j-1),

      and all canonical path flags are realized by a word of length W+P_H.
      Minimizing P_H is exactly a directed Hamilton-path problem on the
      endpoint states, with edge weight d_MTF-1.  Independent resets are only
      the special case P_H=(2H+1)C.

      Cross-depth literal repair can also be shared.  For a proper marked
      coordinate set Z, a hole family H, and trace counts

          h_R=#{S in H:S intersect Z=R},

      define

          Phi_Z(H)=sum_(R subset Z)
             min{h_R, nu(2m-|Z|)+1_(R nonempty)}.

      One fixed-trace cylinder word proves this exact repair cost, and

          max_rank M_rank <= Phi_Z(H) <= sum_rank M_rank.

      Therefore the following portal-trace adaptive theorem PTAD_A is
      sufficient for coefficient one: for every fixed A, construct one
      common H=ceil(A sqrt(m)) adaptive-MTF path system, boundary data,
      ordering, bridges, and proper marked set Z such that

          P_H+Phi_Z(H_H)=o(W).

      The old AD_A ledger implies PTAD_A.  On abstract defect families the
      new trace ledger is strictly weaker: a Gaussian band can have raw
      aggregate defect Theta(W) but Phi_Z=O(W/sqrt(m)).  Realizability of
      that separating pattern by adaptive-MTF data is not proved.  The lower
      sandwich also shows that PTAD_A cannot conceal a linear defect in any
      one depth.  Report and audit: `DIRECT_MTF_AFTER_TWO_NOGOS_20260724.md`
      and `DIRECT_MTF_AFTER_TWO_NOGOS_AUDIT_20260724.md`.

1411. The hard-quota absorber has an exact bounded-rank packet reduction.
      Fix one exact factor and balanced quotas beta(q,S).  If O(q,S) is
      the set of wreaths owning S, then deleting B leaves at most beta(q,S)
      owners exactly when B meets every survival packet

          P subset O(q,S),   |P|=beta(q,S)+1.

      Thus the common-depth deletion problem is precisely vertex cover in
      one packet hypergraph.  If theta is its fractional cover number, tau
      its integral cover number, and R its rank, deterministic threshold
      rounding gives

          theta <= tau <= R theta.

      On every fixed Gaussian window q<=A sqrt(m), balanced quotas give
      R<=2+max c_q=O_A(1).  Hence generic set-cover nonintegrality and the
      final integer absorber cost are not asymptotic obstructions there.

      The packet LP has two further exact forms.  For one owner set its
      constraints are the bottom-(beta+1) order-statistic inequality.  Its
      packing dual compresses to resource variables Y_a with the complete
      wreath-cut system

          sum_a Y_a (k_a-|O_a minus Z|)_+ <= |Z|    (Z subset F),

      proved by a hypersimplex decomposition and capacitated max-flow cuts.
      Moreover, for arbitrary H,

          sum_(q<=H) O_q(F)/c_q <= 3 n H theta(F,beta).

      Therefore theta=o(Cat_m/H) directly implies weighted overload o(W),
      even without rounding; for fixed A, theta=o_A(Cat_m/sqrt(m)) also
      yields a genuine integral quota-safe core.  One common threshold
      rounds an entire exact-factor trajectory with only an O_A(1) loss in
      holding cost and total symmetric-difference recourse.

      The remaining hard-quota gate is now fractional but still correlated:
      construct one exact factor, one common balanced quota system, and a
      survival-packet cover of the displayed small mass.  Report, self-audit,
      and independent cross-audit: `PACKET_HALL_RECOURSE_20260725.md`,
      `PACKET_HALL_RECOURSE_AUDIT_20260725.md`, and
      `PACKET_HALL_RECOURSE_CROSS_AUDIT_20260725.md`.

1412. The unbounded-degree global-portal escape is real at its sharp
      endpoint scale.  For a three-block Boolean SCD product and a global
      Boolean SCD, some coordinate relabelling has central-band same-box
      collision count

          Col_H=O(H W/k).

      At H=Theta(sqrt(k)), restricting to the audited dominant-box target
      family still leaves Theta(W sqrt(k)) flag-box incidence.  Selecting
      the highest-degree Theta(epsilon W/sqrt(k)) global flags and encoding
      each by one reverse-difference suffix block gives a literal nonzero
      word of length at most epsilon W with Omega(epsilon W) useful
      endpoint-box incidences.

      This order is necessary: one central-band endpoint carries at most
      2H+1 targets, so the audited Omega(W) sharing demand forces
      Omega(W/H)=Omega(W/sqrt(k)) genuinely global endpoints.  The portal
      count and chronology are therefore not the missing obstruction.

      Two exact fusion restrictions remain.  The arm-start identity shows
      that isolated or bounded-start-load arms carrying Omega(W) incidence
      still cost Omega(W).  For every one-update core-leading saturated
      flag, the core can change by at most one Johnson exchange.  General
      legal one-update MTF transitions need not be canonical rotor
      transitions; the delayed rotor law is only a sufficient subclass.
      The surviving gate is distinct-target extraction of
      Theta(W) portal targets along one legal MTF trajectory with o(W)
      connectors.  Report and independent audit:
      `GLOBAL_PORTAL_CONSTRUCTION_AFTER_DRAY_20260724.md` and
      `GLOBAL_PORTAL_CONSTRUCTION_AFTER_DRAY_AUDIT_20260725.md`.

1413. Canonical adaptive-MTF portals have an exact residual-depletion
      obstruction.  For ordered partitions Sigma and target
      Pi=(B_1,...,B_s), let t_* be the least target-prefix length whose
      deletion from Sigma leaves the corresponding target suffix.  Then the
      minimum nonempty bridge length is exactly

          d_MTF^+(Sigma,Pi)=max{1,t_*}.

      Assume m-H>=2.  If a canonical radius-H component consumes even one
      coordinate of its initial upper residual, every bridge to a fresh
      canonical state has length at least 2H+1; a full reset costs 2H+2.
      Cyclic strips and odd-cut geodesics always consume their residual, so
      portal sharing saves at most one letter per such component.  For full
      strips with o(W) middle leave, o(W) portal excess forces ell/H->infty.
      Combining this with the unavoidable relative codegree Omega(1/m) and
      the standard growing-uniformity economical-cover condition yields the
      architecture ceiling

          H=o(sqrt(log m)).

      A stronger support dichotomy holds.  If the portal excess and deepest
      upper defect are o(W), only o(W/H) components may be depleted, yet at
      H=A sqrt(m) those components must contain at least

          (exp(-A^2)+o(1))W

      middle owners, so their average length is omega(H).  Thus any
      surviving PTAD construction needs very few super-H-long depleted
      components; cheap residual-preserving pieces cannot carry the deepest
      support.  The result does not obstruct such long components or a
      noncanonical global trajectory.  Report, self-audit, and independent
      corrected-domain audit:
      `ADAPTIVE_MTF_PORTAL_DEPLETION_OBSTRUCTION_20260725.md`,
      `ADAPTIVE_MTF_PORTAL_DEPLETION_OBSTRUCTION_SELF_AUDIT_20260725.md`,
      and
      `ADAPTIVE_MTF_PORTAL_DEPLETION_OBSTRUCTION_CROSS_AUDIT_20260725.md`.

1414. The unrestricted two-endpoint product-box dual is dimension-free and
      gives a new four-box no-go.  Let

          Q=prod_(i<d)[0,p_i],
          B=prod_(i<d)(p_i+1),
          P=sum_(i<d)p_i,
          r=p_d>=P>0.

      If C_L,C_R are the selected left- and right-endpoint class counts for
      the full plateau slab, then every universal range-maximum word obeys

          r[(C_L-B)+(C_R-B)] >= B(r-P),

      and hence

          g_d(p_1,...,p_(d-1),r)
             >= B+ceil[B(r-P)/(2r)].

      An exact shoulder extension remains positive on the boundary r=P.
      On every fixed ray in the closed dominance cone r>=P and every d>=3,
      the local excess is Omega(B).  In particular,

          liminf_(t->infinity)
          [g_4(t,t,t,3t)-(t+1)^3]/t^3 >=49/512.

      The cap-free shoulder counts, asymptotic formula, and 49/512 constant
      have been independently cross-audited.  Thus uniform compact-balanced
      four-box width+o(R^3), GF4, and every parent theorem implying such a
      local bound are false on this sector.  The obstructed four-chain
      height windows have positive SCD mass, so independently paid four-box
      aggregation incurs Omega(W) excess.  This remains a local/parent
      obstruction: equal and polygon-interior boxes, high-degree cross-box
      sharing, and arbitrary global fusion are not ruled out.

      Reports and cross-audit:
      `MATH_ATTACK_A3_ENDPOINT_DUAL_HIGHER_DIM_20260724.md`,
      `MATH_ATTACK_G3_FOURBOX_ENDPOINT_DUAL_20260724.md`, and
      `FOURBOX_ENDPOINT_DUALS_CROSS_AUDIT_20260725.md`.

1415. The super-H-long residual-consuming escape from item 1413 is
      genuinely realizable at a nontrivially growing scale.  Put

          ell=floor[log m/(32 log log m)].

      For every H->infinity with H=o(log m/log log m), a projected
      two-row strip hypergraph (middle plus deepest upper rank only) has a
      matching leaving o(W) vertices.  Its selected cyclic components have

          p=(1+o(1))W/(2 ell)=o(W/H),

      length 2 ell=omega(H), contain W-o(W) middle owners, and expose
      N_H-o(W) globally distinct rank-(m+H) masks.  Even independent exact
      initializations have portal excess (2H+1)p=o(W), asymptotically
      matching the depletion lower bound 2Hp+1.  Therefore there is a
      literal W+o(W) word covering ranks m and m+H; the symmetric
      three-row version covers m-H,m,m+H.

      More generally, for any selected signed-depth set D containing zero,
      with r=|D| and H=max|d|,

          r H log log m=o(log m)

      suffices for one literal W+o(W) word covering every rank m+d,
      d in D.  This interpolates the full-band
      H=o(sqrt(log m/log log m)) result and the fixed-row
      H=o(log m/log log m) result.

      After one coordinate relabelling, the already fused middle endpoints
      of these components also carry Omega(HW) useful dominant-box
      endpoint incidences.  Thus long components simultaneously realize the
      positive side of the depletion and global-portal ledgers at this
      scale.

      A complementary obstruction shows that the existing fixed-kernel
      linear-code translation tiling has depth-H upper support at most a
      2 ell/2^H fraction of its middle mass; it therefore fails at Gaussian
      and tail-killing depths.  Varying active frames/kernels or a different
      global construction is necessary beyond the projected-strip range.
      Report and independent audit: `LONG_COMPONENT_MTF_CONSTRUCTION_20260725.md`
      and `LONG_COMPONENT_MTF_CONSTRUCTION_CROSS_AUDIT_20260725.md`.

1416. The exact finite frontier was re-audited at the first unresolved
      dimension.  The certified interval remains

          465 <= nu(11) <= 477,

      but two large local construction neighbourhoods are now rigorously

      288->808 at position 159; independent suffix-state DFS and BFS prove

          477*476*2047 = 464,775,444

      words obtained by deleting one entry of the certified 477-word and

      476-word.  These are exact neighbourhood exclusions, not a global
      lower bound.  The same audit records the current physical equality

1417. The next rooted K=11 construction neighbourhood is also closed with
      checked proof certificates.  Start from either of the only two
      one-replacement roots surviving the eleven-endpoint inclusion-width
      gate, namely the changes 288->800 and 288->808 at position 159 of the
      465-entry partial word.  Make one further arbitrary nonzero
      replacement and append eleven arbitrary entries.  Two independent

          4b32cbbf68490a969191a46bdbe737e3cec87437cd65bcfcd87957a5f11c65cd.

      This is not the unrestricted two-replacement theorem, because two

1418. The endpoint-ordered physical equality gate at K=11 now has an exact
      two-token reservoir form.  On each of the six alternating paths, let
      a_i be the missing coordinate in the matched source/target state.  At
      every interior index i>=3, put

          R_i=S_i\{a_(i-3),a_(i-2),a_(i-1)}.

      Then R_i is a two-set,

          S_i=R_i+{a_(i-3),a_(i-2),a_(i-1)},
          U_i=R_i+{a_(i-3),a_(i-2),a_(i-1),a_i},

      and the next transition either keeps R_i fixed while deleting the
      oldest recent a-symbol, or replaces one token of R_i by that oldest
      symbol.  The next a-symbol is chosen from the five-coordinate
      complement.  Conversely these local rules are exactly the two
      physical no-lazy inequalities.  The 462 source sets S_i enumerate all
      five-sets and the 462 U_i enumerate all six-sets.

      The lower and upper four-colours are explicit functions of this cache
      state.  Their paired occurrence map i->(B_i,Y_i) is injective; a lower
      colour cannot recur within three positions; mu_B<=3 and mu_Y<=6.
      For every three-set Q, every run of Q subset S_i has length at most
      three, yielding R_S(Q)>=10 and

          sum_(B superset Q) mu_B(B) <=18.

      The complete three-set run histogram is

          N_1=1422+z_1, N_2=924-2z_1, N_3=450+z_1,

      where z_1 is the number of one-state path components.  These are new
      temporal constraints but do not yet contradict the simultaneous
      319/319 shadow-support requirements.  During audit, a reversed-sign
      recurrence in an agent summary was corrected; the authoritative law
      is B_(i+1)=B_i-b_(i+1)+a_i.  Full proof:
      `K11_TWO_TOKEN_RESERVOIR_AUTOMATON_AUDIT_20260725.md`.

1419. In the exact c=6,d=0 K=11 design-quotient branch, the one-sided
      upper- and lower-colour Hall attacks are now closed as possible
      contradiction routes.  The design polarity

          phi:C([11],4)->K

      is a bijection.  If Q=phi(C) and
      [11]\Q=C+{x,y}, then a central K-connector of source colour Q has
      exactly the six possible upper repairs

          Y=(C\{c,d})+{x,y},  {c,d} subset C.

      The resulting directed repair graph on the 330 four-sets is exactly
      6-in/6-out regular and has no directed two-cycle.  If E is the set
      of 128 external colours and M its 202-complement, then the induced
      bipartite repair graph R[M,M] has at least 444 edges and hence a
      matching of size at least 74.  Only 65 distinct K-connector repairs
      are needed after granting 126 useful H-star repairs, so this route
      has nine units of worst-case slack.

      Dually, the 252 H-segment ports have exact four-facet lists.  Their
      port--facet graph is left 4-regular and right degree at most four, so
      Hall gives an SDR of all 252 lower colours.  These two SDRs cannot be
      combined independently: a real K connector must pair two compatible
      ports and simultaneously fixes its upper colour, both adjacent lower
      colours, path degree/acyclicity, and the two no-lazy conditions.
      Therefore only the coupled connector-port problem remains on this
      branch.  Full hand proof: `K11_PHI_REPAIR_GRAPH_THEOREM_20260725.md`.

1420. The canonical-wreath cycle-fusion route now has an exact physical
      splice criterion.  If a canonical cycle is written in cyclic order
      z_0,...,z_10 and its transition after D_i is spliced into a second
      physical path beginning at S'_h, let beta be the unique coordinate
      outside D_i union S'_h.  The seam is physical if and only if

          beta != a_(i-2),a_(i-1),
          b'_h != a_(i-1),a_i,
          b'_(h+1) != a_i.

      At a canonical tail a_i=z_i and b_i=z_(i-5).  Of the four facets of
      U_i=[11]\D_i lying outside the old eleven-cycle, exactly two pass the
      backward-looking tests: they omit beta=z_(i-4) or beta=z_(i-3).
      The remaining forward tests are

          b'_h notin {z_(i-1),z_i},  b'_(h+1) != z_i.

      The new lower and complementary-upper colours are respectively

          B*=U_i\{z_i,beta},  Y*=D_i\{a'_h}.

      Hence ordinary quotient connectivity is insufficient: the same
      selected cross arcs must satisfy this two-candidate seam graph, turn
      the 42 canonical cycles into six paths, and retain 319 colours in
      both shadow ledgers.  Full proof:
      `K11_CANONICAL_WREATH_SPLICE_CRITERION_20260725.md`.

1421. The coupled connector obstruction is also completely localised at
      prescribed H-segment ports.  For a free central K connector
      Q=phi(C), an incoming two-token cache state protects two elements of
      Q.  Each chosen free outgoing quotient port has five possible source

## 336. Global off-spine labelled routing is now an exact finite object

1473. The failed first/last-occurrence lift has been replaced by a complete
      unrestricted owner-chronology formulation in

          MATH_THEOREM_H_GLOBAL_FLAT_OFFSPINE_LABELLED_ROUTING_20260728.md.

      For the odd diamond lift on old ground set `[2r-1]`, the child middle
      owners split as

          A_C=C+xy,  X_T=T+x,  Y_T=T+y,  U_V=V.

      Lemma 1.1 gives the complete Johnson edge list.  Binary edge and
      endpoint variables form one Hamilton path exactly by the degree
      equations `deg(v)=2-epsilon_v`, `sum epsilon=2`, and every proper cut
      being crossed.  This formulation retains all off-spine edges and all
      shared-owner passages; it does not impose a first-occurrence selector.

1474. Four exact signed immediate-lower ledgers hold for every such path:

          rho_xy-h_xy = b-a,
          rho_x-h_x   = e_AX-c_X,
          rho_y-h_y   = e_AY-c_Y,
          rho_0-h_0   = u+e_XY-eta_U-b.

      The `A` sector has an exact flag-forest model: choose one flag
      `R subset T`, `|T\R|=2`, for every rank-`r-2` colour.  Acyclicity and
      degree at most two are equivalent to a Catalan linear forest with
      exactly `b=C_r` components.  Its fresh-owner endpoint completion has
      the exact capacitated Hall cut

          |Z| <= sum_{C contained in some T in Z} (2-deg_F(C)).

      The inclusion-graph upper cuts are automatic, and the assigned ports
      admit an exact `X/Y` two-colouring.  Scope: this is a constructive
      fresh-owner subarchitecture.  It excludes legal `A-X_T-A` sharing,
      and installation still needs residual owner degrees and global cuts;
      failure of this Hall cut is not an unrestricted no-go.

1475. The old-only lower layer has an exact ternary star description.  Each
      rank-`r` label `T` chooses either a `UU` pair in its cofacet star, one
      `U` cross-port singleton, or the vertical edge `X_TY_T`; the vertex
      equations are

          deg_F_U(V) + #{T: pi_T={V}} = 2-epsilon_V.

      Hence `u+e_XY-eta_U=b`, and empty-signature `US*` is exactly the
      requirement that every old upper target be the union of a subpath of
      one `U` component.  Direct `A-(X/Y)-U` endpoint flags have two possible
      rank-`r` intermediates.  Their one-shore physical-port SDR exists iff
      the candidate multigraph is a pseudoforest; with both shores it exists
      iff `|F|<=2|V(F)|` for every flag subfamily.  These are exact local
      occurrence/port theorems, not substitutes for the global Hamilton
      cuts.

1476. Feasible global flat data `(T,phi)` now have a necessary and sufficient
      coordinate characterization.  For `J_i=[i,i+d]`, put

          E_p(T)=intersection_{i:p in J_i} T_i,
          P_p=E_p(T) intersection intersection_{S:p in I_S} S.

      Then `(T,phi)` is realized by a nonzero word iff

          P_p is nonempty for every p,
          union_{p in J_i} P_p = T_i for every middle cell,
          union_{p in I_S} P_p = S for every lower pin.

      The word `P` is the unique coordinatewise maximal realization.  A
      core `C` with `D^d C=T` yields the constructive equivalent `(N),(P)`:
      every installed pin contains its core cells, and every coordinate of
      its target survives some maximal envelope cell.  Together with the
      Hamilton cuts and simple selected-subpath witnesses for every upper
      target, this is an iff theorem for the Johnson-flat lane at length
      `B(n)`.  Thus independent rowwise Hall tests are formally insufficient.
